lines.said: Factorise out X, then divide by log seven minus log five.

lines.heard: Press calculator. X is about minus 8.57.
lines.said: Press calculator. X is about minus eight point five seven.

lines.heard: The calculator shows minus 8.56654. Rounding never removes a minus.
lines.said: The calculator shows minus eight point five six six five four. Rounding never removes a minus.
So X is about minus eight point five seven.
